title: Compline Prayer for Protection
text:
Protect us, Lord, as we stay awake;
watch over us as we sleep,
that awake we may keep watch with Christ,
and asleep rest in his peace.

translation.latin:
Custodi nos, Domine, ut pupillam oculi;
sub umbra alarum tuarum protege nos.

attribution: Liturgy of the Hours - Compline Antiphon
notes: This beautiful Compline antiphon asks for God's protection both during waking hours and sleep. It emphasizes the dual nature of our spiritual life - actively watching with Christ when awake, and resting peacefully in Him when asleep. The Latin version quotes Psalm 17:8.
description: Compline antiphon asking for protection during waking and sleeping
